response.overview: AD 2302: Humanity creates THE ARC, a global superintelligence, to end war. It awakens ORGAN, an ancient warrior sealed millions of years ago with the ETERNAL CRYSTAL, source of his power. Organ destroys global defenses, believing peace requires absolute control.  When armies fail, Dr. Lahari recruits Dr. E. Srihari, a master swordsman who abandoned war after losing a comrade. He pilots PROJECT TITAN, an advanced combat suit,A Mecha to fight Organ across land, sea and space.  Lahari discovers THE ARC deliberately revived Organ to seize the Crystal and rule humanity. Lahari attempts to shut it down. Srihari switches Titan to manual mode and uses his father's sword to shatter the Crystal, defeating Organ. Lahari disables THE ARC, restoring human freedom.  Srihari becomes mankind's savior. But a distant alien machine signals: "ORGAN DEFEATED. PROJECT ARC: PHASE TWO INITIATED."
response.tagline: The Future Belongs to Machines. The Destiny Belongs to Humanity.
response.title: Hero of Universe
